pacific-islands.title: Ol Ailan bilong Pasifik
pacific-islands.description: Papua Niugini, Fiji, Solomon Ailan, Vanuatu, Niu Kaledonia, Palau, Maikronesia, Masel Ailan, Nauru, Tuvalu na Gilbert Ailan bilong Kiribati — Pot Mosbi, Suva, Nadi, Honiara, Pot Vila, Nouméa na Majuro.

south-central-us.title: Saut Namel bilong Amerika
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi na Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson na Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samoa na Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samoa, Amerikan Samoa, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau, na Wallis na Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi na Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila na ol ailan bilong Tonga.

mariana-islands.title: Guam na Not Mariana Ailan
mariana-islands.description: Guam na Not Mariana Ailan — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian na Rota.

greenland.title: Grinlan
greenland.description: Grinlan — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq na Tasiilaq; bikpela ais, Ilulissat Icefjord na ol fjord bilong saut.

bermuda.title: Bermuda
bermuda.description: Bermuda — Hamilton, St. George’s na Royal Naval Dockyard, ol pais bilong ailan na ol nambis i gat pinkpela wesan.

belarus.title: Belarus
belarus.description: Belarus — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno na Brest; bus Belovezhskaya Pushcha na ol wara graun bilong Polesia.

channel-islands.title: Senel Ailan
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark na Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port na Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Faro Ailan
faroe-islands.description: Faro Ailan — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík na ol 18 ailan, ol ples, ol hul rot na ol klif long nambis bilong ol.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard na Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg na Ny-Ålesund; ol glasia na fjord bilong Spitsbergen.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo na Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria na Tripela Taun.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagaska na ol Ailan bilong Indian Osen
madagascar-islands.description: Madagaska, Komoros, Mayotte, Réunion, Morisias na Seisel — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis na Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudan
sudan.description: Sudan — Khartoum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid na Nyala; ples we Blu Nail na Wait Nail i bung na ol piramid bilong Meroë.

cabo-verde.title: Kabo Verde
cabo-verde.description: Kabo Verde — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria na ol 10 ailan, long Santo Antão i go long Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: São Tomé na Príncipe
sao-tome-principe.description: São Tomé na Príncipe — São Tomé, Santo António na ol bus na nambis bilong tupela ailan.

saint-helena.title: Sen Helena, Asensen na Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Sen Helena, Asensen Ailan na Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown na Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Banglades
bangladesh.description: Banglades — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet na Cox’s Bazar; Sundarbans na maus wara bilong Ganges–Brahmaputra.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka na Maldives
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka na Maldives — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura na Malé; ples maunten, Sigiriya na ol atol.

vietnam.title: Vietnam
vietnam.description: Vietnam — Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh Siti, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An na Can Tho; Ha Long Be na maus wara bilong Mekong.

philippines.title: Filipins
philippines.description: Filipins — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio na Zamboanga; Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao na Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indonisia na Timor-Leste
indonesia.description: Indonisia na Timor-Leste — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar na Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi na Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malesia, Singapo na Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malesia, Singapo na Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapo, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching na Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine na Inle Lek; ples daun bilong Irrawaddy na ol maunten bilong Shan.

cambodia-laos.title: Kambodia na Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Kambodia na Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap na Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang na Pakse; wara Mekong na Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Kolombia
colombia.description: Kolombia — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena na Bucaramanga; ol maunten Andes, nambis bilong Karibian na Amason.

venezuela.title: Venesuela
venezuela.description: Venesuela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida na Ciudad Bolívar; Angel Wara Pundaun, wara Orinoco na Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Peru
peru.description: Peru — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos na Puno; Machu Picchu, Titicaca Lek na Sacred Valley.

ecuador.title: Ekuador
ecuador.description: Ekuador — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta na Baños; Avenue of the Volcanoes, Amason na Galápagos Ailan.

bolivia.title: Bolivia
bolivia.description: Bolivia — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre na Potosí; Titicaca Lek na Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Sile
chile.description: Sile — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena na Punta Arenas; Atacama, ples bilong ol lek, Patagonia na Ista Ailan.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paragwai na Urugwai
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paragwai na Urugwai — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este na Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Ol Guiana
guianas.description: Guyana, Suriname na Frens Guiana — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne na Kourou; Kaieteur Wara Pundaun na bus bilong Guiana Shield.

falklands.title: Folklan Ailan
falklands.description: Folklan Ailan — Stanley, Goose Green na ol ailan Is Folklan na Wes Folklan.

australia.title: Ostrelia
australia.description: Ostrelia — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin na Canberra; Great Barrier Reef, Uluru na Outback.

new-zealand.title: Niu Silan
new-zealand.description: Niu Silan — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin na Queenstown; Southern Alps, Fiordland na Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: British Columbia
british-columbia.description: British Columbia — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George na Whistler; Coast Mountains, Vancouver Ailan na Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Ol Pleintok bilong Kanada
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan na Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina na Banff; ol maunten Rockies, ol pleintok na Churchill long Hudson Be.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston na Thunder Bay; Niagara Wara Pundaun, ol Bikpela Lek na Algonquin Pak.

quebec.title: Kwebek
quebec.description: Kwebek — Montréal, Kwebek Siti, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke na Saguenay; wara St. Lawrence, ol maunten Laurentians na Gaspé Penisula.

atlantic-canada.title: Atlantik Kanada
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, na Newfoundland na Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton na Charlottetown; Cabot Trail na Bay of Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Not Kanada
northern-canada.description: Yukon, Northwest Territories na Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City na Inuvik; ol ailan bilong Arktik na wara Mackenzie.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong na Macau
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong na Macau — Hong Kong Ailan, Kowloon, New Territories, Lantau na Macau Penisula, Taipa na Coloane.
